name: methods
value: Cross-tabulation was performed for row by  column. Statistical significance was assessed using Pearson's chi-squared test. The odds ratio comparing column 2 versus 1 for row 2 versus 1 is reported with a 95% confidence interval. The risk ratio comparing column 2 versus 1 for row 2 versus 1 is reported with a 95% confidence interval. The risk difference comparing column 2 versus 1 for row 2 versus 1 is reported with a 95% confidence interval. Analysis performed in Stata 17 (StataCorp, College Station, TX).
